_comment: Main story goals in order. A goal is done when all its 'done' flags are set (or any later goal is done). 'where' names the place to go. Side goals show in the Goals list while their 'show' flag is set and their 'done' flag is not. 'chapter' titles the story part; a side goal's 'progress' flags show as (k/n). 'act' names the act shown above the chapter. A side goal's 'where' names the place; 'stages' (list of {text, where}) replaces the text with the step stored in story_vars q_<id>_stage.

main.text: Talk to Aldo downstairs in the lighthouse.
main.act: Act I: The Hush of Veydal

main.text: Visit Kestra at the Map House in Brindlewick.
main.act: Act I: The Hush of Veydal

main.text: Mend the three Rifts: the Cinder Rift past Thornridge, the Mist Rift east of Crowcrest and the Tidewater Rift under the Saltmarsh.
main.act: Act I: The Hush of Veydal

main.text: Kestra is waiting at the Brindlewick dock.
main.act: Act I: The Hush of Veydal

main.text: Go home to the lighthouse and tell Aldo what Kestra said.
main.act: Act I: The Hush of Veydal
Act I: The Hush of Veydal
main.text: Find the six pages of Mirela's map book and take them up to the lamp room.

main.act: Act II: The Colours of Corvane
main.text: Aldo is rowing the ferry himself. Cross the lake with him from the Brindlewick pier.

main.act: Act II: The Colours of Corvane
main.text: Follow the river road to Madderby and find the cartographers' guild house.

main.act: Act II: The Colours of Corvane
main.text: Mend the Rain Rift in the Woadfen and the Mirror Rift past Stillwater.

main.act: Act II: The Colours of Corvane
main.text: Mend the Root Rift under the Woadfen moor. Kestra waits at its mouth.

main.act: Act II: The Colours of Corvane
main.text: Something is wrong with Kestra's Tatter. Find her in Madderby.

main.act: Act II: The Colours of Corvane
main.text: Cross the Greyreach toward the Wide Rift. Someone is waiting on the ridge.

main.act: Act II: The Colours of Corvane
main.text: Reach the edge of the Wide Rift north of the Greyreach.

main.act: Act II: The Colours of Corvane
main.text: Tell Ysolde at the guild house what you found at the Wide Rift.

main.act: Act III: The Plates of Ashmere
main.text: Take the mountain railway from the Greyreach to Ashmere.

main.act: Act III: The Plates of Ashmere
main.text: Find master graver Halvard in the gravers' hall in Cinderfold.

main.act: Act III: The Plates of Ashmere
main.text: Mend the Kiln Rift up the ridge and the Glass Rift past the Saltglass flats.

main.act: Act III: The Plates of Ashmere
main.text: Veit Harrow is in Cinderfold. Hear what he wants, then give him your answer.

main.act: Act III: The Plates of Ashmere
main.text: Veit is engraving a plate to still the Wide Rift. Stop him in the gravers' hall.

main.act: Act III: The Plates of Ashmere
main.text: Climb the silent lighthouse on the Saltglass flats and mend the Shade Rift inside it.

main.act: Act IV: The Sun of Solenne
main.text: Take the sand road south from the Saltglass flats to Ochrewell and mend the three Rifts of Solenne.

main.act: Act III: The Plates of Ashmere
main.text: Go to the far end of the Wide Rift and step into the Undrawn.

main.act: Finale: Where the Map Ends
main.text: Walk to the end of the Undrawn. Someone is waiting there.

main.act: Epilogue: The Open Map
main.text: Bring the news to Ysolde at the guild house in Madderby.

main.act: Epilogue: The Open Map
main.text: Go home to the lighthouse in Brindlewick.

main.act: Epilogue: The Open Map
main.text: Open the map book at the lighthouse one more time.

side.text: Find the six pages of Mirela's map book. Kestra has one; the storm blew the rest to Fernstair, Crowcrest, Thornridge, the Saltmarsh and Murk Hollow.
Kestra wants to test you on the Crowcrest path.
Someone in Fernstair has something for you.
Light up the dark gallery in Murk Hollow, behind the Crowcrest cliff.
Light the old miners' lamps in Murk Hollow in the chalked order.
Show the Brindlewick fisher a Kelpup.
Show the Fernstair rambler a Zephlet.
Bring a Wickit to the Saltmarsh reedcutter.
Kestra needs a partner in the Saltmarsh.
A hushed swarm lurks in a dark corner of Murk Hollow.
The Hush still smoulders at the heart of the Cinder Rift.
Something stirs at the bottom of the Tidewater Rift.
The fog still knots itself together at the heart of the Mist Rift.
A new Rift tore open east of Crowcrest: the Mist Rift. Warden Brisa is lost in it.
A Rift has opened under the Woadfen moor: the Root Rift. Warden Darrow keeps it.
The silent lighthouse on the Saltglass flats hides a Rift: the Shade Rift.
The wind towers of Ochrewell have stopped breathing: the Tower Rift. Warden Aurelio grieves in style.
The oasis east of Ochrewell has run dry: the Oasis Rift. Warden Kaia says nobody is to blame.
The sundial under the sun palace has stopped: the Sun Rift. Warden Emrys is waiting, slowly.
Mirela hid three letters to Aldo in Veydal: in the lighthouse, on Fernstair and by the pond in Thornridge.
The child in Brindlewick wants their hushed Puddlet to wake up.
Pim the archivist is looking for Mirela's lost letters, three in Corvane and three in Ashmere.
Three dye families in Madderby want to see Spirlings with their colour back.
Veit Harrow once worked at the guild. His old corner still holds clues.
The Brass Veil keeps a cistern under its counting house in Ochrewell. Find out what it counts.
Corin Lusk, heir of the Brass Veil, wants to buy your team. Beat him three times.
Old Mags wants the eight brass seals the Veil nailed onto Ochrewell. She melts them into spoons.
Qadir wants the five worst IOUs of Ochrewell for a bonfire.
The Veil prepaid three graves with Undertaker Bex. Find out who they are for.

stages.text: The Veil prepaid three graves with Undertaker Bex. Find out who they are for.
The Veil keeps its orders in the lowest room of its cistern. Read the order book.
You know whose graves they are. Tell Bex.
Beat Factor Lusk in his strongroom, then go back to Bex.
Three rude headstones, paid in full.

side.text: Someone pays wages in the Soot Vaults under Cinderfold. Nobody who collects comes back up.
Juno Sallow races you for the wage plates. Beat her at the station, on the Saltglass flats and in the Vaults.
Archivist Brisk wants rubbings of the Ruskweber clan's eight hidden wage plates.
Census Man Mott wants to count six kinds of Spirling from the Vaults. Bring each one in your team.
Halvard's hand press is missing three parts. Foreman Gorse is very keen to help.
Tibb's Mirkmole ran into the Soot Vaults. Tibb is small and very sad about it.
Kiln-Keeper Tovan needs an Ember Spirling to light the old town kiln.
Engraver Pell needs ash from three rooms of the Soot Vaults for a Wardens' plate.
Old Warden Harl trades one story for each sack of kiln coal from the Vaults.
Bram from Crowcrest lost three Shalebats over the ash. His cousin Rook is helping. Allegedly.
Widow Marn wants the clan's five IOUs from the Soot Vaults, so she can burn them. She says.
Busker Wenna wants the three lost verses of the salt flats song, scratched into the walls of the Soot Vaults.
Crake is beaten, but Ashmere already hired a new Paymaster. She works in the archive under the strongroom.
Nib Wexley, a quay rat with a fast mouth, keeps turning up to prove he is the best tamer in Corvane.
Mother Gaunt wants four overdue debts collected: on the quay, in the Woadfen, at Stillwater and in Greyreach.
Mortimer Glum the undertaker needs three mourners who will cry for a fee.
Corbin the Featherman wants twelve grey rook feathers from all over Corvane.
Harbourmaster Quill pays bounties for four rascals. Minus fees.
Lucky Fenwick runs Spirling races on the pond at Stillwater.

stages.text: Lucky Fenwick runs Spirling races on the pond at Stillwater.
Your Spirling lost by a nose. Ask the jockey, Wee Morag, what happened.
The race was fixed. Make Lucky Fenwick pay up.

side.text: The Rook Vault under Greyreach hides a hoard. Raise the feathers in each room and reach the bottom.
Somebody bought Nib's notes on you. Find the Quay Book.

stages.text: Somebody bought Nib's notes on you. Look for the Quay Book's drop in the Woadfen.
A courier collects the Quay Book's pages at Stillwater. Catch the courier.
The ledger goes to the harbour office. Confront Harbourmaster Quill.

side.text: Vetch, the poor cousin of the dye families, wants a crate of grey dye carried to the Woadfen.

stages.text: Vetch, the poor cousin of the dye families, wants a crate of grey dye carried to the Woadfen.
Bring Vetch's crate to Moss-eye Jory in the Woadfen.
The crate was full of rocks. Go back to Vetch in Madderby.

side.text: Hobb dares you to climb the Greyreach Ladder: five tamers up the cliff.
Sorrel the naturalist wants to see six of Corvane's own Spirlings in your team.
Ma Rook of the Rook Post needs five letters delivered across Corvane. Don't read them.
